usageNotes: Use this endpoint to confirm the exact PVE release and pve-manager package version running on a specific node — useful before applying updates, validating cluster homogeneity, or troubleshooting API compatibility. The node must be online and reachable; calling it against an offline node will return a connection error. Any authenticated user or API token is permitted ('user: all'), so no elevated privilege is required.

examples.summary: Fetch version info from a node named 'pve01'

tips: Compare the 'version' field across all cluster nodes to detect version drift after a rolling upgrade.
The 'repoid' (short git commit hash) pinpoints the exact build when reporting bugs to the Proxmox community.
This endpoint is available even when the node is in maintenance mode, making it a lightweight liveness probe.
